event.text: I recommend a Counsel clinician review this request in this thread, with a same-day service-hours target, to discuss a physical therapy referral for your long-standing back ache. Nothing you describe points to an urgent problem now. If you develop new loss of bladder or bowel control, numbness around the groin or buttocks, or significant or worsening leg weakness, get emergency assessment immediately rather than waiting for a reply. For fever with back pain, or unexplained weight loss, contact a clinician promptly.
